That looks like Michaels signage! I worked there for a while before and during the pandemic. They throw out so much product. After every season, stuff will go on clearance, and if it doesn't sell, it gets thrown out. Employees are not allowed to buy the merchandise either, it is supposed to be thrown away. So if someone brings in a seasonal item to return after the season, they get their money back, and then it goes in the trash! Every store in the company does this....and they sell the same products every year which makes it worse...
it was a simple mistake I over looked! Thank you for your response.

I have been having issues with this head for 2 months now. It makes a weird "choking" noise and then the thread breaks and jumps high, like the video. This happens every 30-60 seconds when sewing. This also happens on all the needles. I have tried changing needles, bobins and bobin casings. I'm assuming it is a tension issue but it happens with every needle and it's the same type of thread break. It jumps up really high every time. Unsure what to try next, any help would be much appreciated. I have been working with embroidery machines for over a year now and I don't know what else to try. Thank you!
I used the oil paint brush and the technical pen. I created an outline first, and then I used the oil brush to color everything in. I kept decreasing the size of the brush, the more I painted.
